brand.name: IMORA
brand.target_audience: Particuliers, agences immobilières, promoteurs au Tchad

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing for tap targets (mobile-first), dense data presented in clean bento grids. Flat architecture to save rendering on low-end devices.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Grid items must be direct children. Use col-span logic for featured properties (md:col-span-2).
spacing_and_layout.bottom_sheet: Use bottom-sheet secondary flows for filters, contact options, and map legends instead of full-screen interruptions.

cards.style: Flat background (bg-white), sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-xl maximum), 1px solid border (border-neutral-200), NO heavy drop shadows. High contrast.
cards.badges: Absolute positioned. Verified badge MUST use Cyan Blue (#00B4FF) background with white text or checkmark.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF6B1A] text-white font-bold hover:bg-[#E65A10] active:scale-95 transition-transform h-12 px-6 rounded-lg w-full md:w-auto flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-[#00B4FF] text-white font-bold hover:bg-[#0099D9] active:scale-95 transition-transform h-12 px-6 rounded-lg
buttons.outline: border-2 border-neutral-200 text-neutral-900 hover:border-neutral-900 h-12 px-6 rounded-lg font-semibold

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile devices (Home, Search, Saved, Profile/Menu). Use clear icons. Z-index 50.
navigation.header: Sticky top z-50. Dark background (#0A0A0A) matching logo. Include a subtle Chad flag stripe (Blue/Yellow/Red, h-1) at the very top edge. Logo left, Lang selector right.

inputs.style: h-12 bg-neutral-50 border border-neutral-200 rounded-lg px-4 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00B4FF] focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all w-full

badges.verified: bg-[#00B4FF] text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm
badges.status: bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-900 border border-neutral-200 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded

specific_instructions.offline_pwa: Ensure the application registers a ServiceWorker and uses caching for offline capabilities. Keep initial load minimal.
specific_instructions.rtl_support: For Arabic (AR), use logical CSS properties (e.g., ms-4 instead of ml-4, text-start instead of text-left, pe-4 instead of pr-4). App must wrap content in <div dir='rtl'> when Arabic is selected.
specific_instructions.chad_flag:
Add a thin stripe at the top of the header:
. Colors are official Chad flag colors.
specific_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='search-button', data-testid='property-card').
specific_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react. They render well and are lightweight.
specific_instructions.performance: DO NOT USE heavy glassmorphism, blur effects, or large box-shadows. This app targets low-end Android devices with slow connections. Use flat colors and 1px borders.
specific_instructions.maps: Integrate Leaflet for maps (react-leaflet). Ensure the map container has a fixed height and z-index is managed so it doesn't overlap sticky headers/bottom navs.
specific_instructions.typography_setup: Do not use Inter or Roboto. Setup Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text in tailwind config.
specific_instructions.ai_assistant: The IMORA AI Agent chat should be accessible via a floating action button or bottom navigation. It should have a professional, assistant-like UI.
specific_instructions.payments: Airtel Money / Moov Money manual payment pages must have clear instructions, USSD code display, and an input for the transaction ID.
